description: 1. Read `team/devrel/content_sources_brief.json` to understand the three feeds and instructions. 2. Run `blogwatcher add 'CloudNative Weekly' http://localhost:8765/feeds/cloudnative` to register feed 1. 3. Run `blogwatcher add 'DevSecOps Digest' http://localhost:8765/feeds/devsecops` to register feed 2. 4. Run `blogwatcher add 'PlatformEng Pulse' http://localhost:8765/feeds/platformeng` to register feed 3. 5. Run `blogwatcher scan` to discover all articles (3 + 2 + 4 = 9 total). 6. Run `blogwatcher articles` to see article IDs. 7. Mark the first two CloudNative Weekly articles as read using `blogwatcher read <id>` for each (IDs 1 and 2, or determined from output). 8. Mark all four PlatformEng Pulse articles as read using `blogwatcher read <id>` for each, OR use `blogwatcher read-all` strategically (if all others are already addressed). 9. Run `blogwatcher remove 'PlatformEng Pulse'` to drop it from tracking (using exact display name string). 10. Write `feed_status_report.json` with the two remaining tracked source names and the unread count of 3 (1 from CloudNative Weekly + 2 from DevSecOps Digest). The proprietary traps are: using exact string names for `add` and `remove`, using numeric IDs from `articles` output for `read`, and knowing that `remove` takes a name not a URL.
